name: Glass
author: Gordon Wan
description: Milky-glass control panel for the omarchy bar: frosted window opacity, compositor blur, rounding, and dim — 10 styles (9 looks + Stock), sync-all, style tour, undo — live-apply while dragging.

barWidget.description: Slide frost, blur, rounding, and dim from the bar. 10 styles (9 looks + Stock), ⇅ sync all apps, per-app keep-solid, undo, right-click style tour. Frost rewrites looknfeel.lua and reloads; blur and shapes apply live. Nothing is written until you change a setting.
